AUTHENTICITY Harvested high in the Himalayas and the Altai Mountains of Siberia. Processed in accordance with the centuries-old tradition. TESTING Our products are tested by 3rd party ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratories for safety and efficacy. PURITY One of the highest purity standards in the market. No artificial additives or fillers. Up to 99.9% pure shilajit. Where is our shilajit from? We source our shilajit from diverse regions of the Himalayan and Altai mountains. 16,000 FT Gilgit-Baltistan Region Our shilajit is sourced from the pristine region of Gilgit-Baltistan in Pakistan, an area renowned for its pure and potent natural resources. Nestled within the Himalayan Mountain Range, Gilgit-Baltistan provides an ideal environment for harvesting shilajit of exceptional quality. The high altitudes and untouched landscapes contribute to the unique mineral composition and bioactive properties of our shilajit. By choosing shilajit from this region, you are experiencing a product that embodies the ancient wisdom and natural purity of the Himalayas. 16,000 FT Sikkim Region We also obtain shilajit from the Sikkim region of the Himalayas, known for its rich and diverse mineral deposits. The Sikkim Himalayas offer a unique environment where shilajit forms over centuries, absorbing essential nutrients from the surrounding rocks and vegetation. This region’s shilajit is celebrated for its high potency and purity, reflecting the deep connection between the land and its traditional use in Ayurvedic medicine. By incorporating shilajit from the Sikkim Himalayas, we ensure a product that harnesses the best of both worlds, providing you with a powerful and authentic natural supplement. 14,000 FT Altai Mountains Our shilajit collection extends to the rugged Altai Mountains of Siberia, a region known for its untouched wilderness and ancient geological formations. The Altai Mountains produce shilajit that is distinct in its composition, enriched by the unique flora and mineral-rich soil of this remote area. This Siberian shilajit undergoes minimal processing to preserve its natural integrity and bioactive properties, ensuring a potent supplement that stands out for its exceptional quality. By including shilajit from the Altai Mountains, we bring you a diverse and robust product that captures the essence of Siberia’s pristine environment.
